title: Email connections
subtitle: Send applications from your own mailbox, and read the replies that belong to them.
empty.hint: Connect Outlook below to send applications through your own account.
error.load: Your connections could not be loaded.
outlook.title: Outlook / Microsoft 365
outlook.description: Boba sends you to Microsoft to sign in. It never sees your password, and it asks only for the access below.
mode.send_only.hint: Boba writes and sends applications. Reply parsing stays off.
mode.read_send.hint: Boba may also read the replies about your applications, locally.
scopes.heading: Microsoft will ask you to allow
scopes.Mail.Read: Read your mail — only messages that match your applications
scopes.offline_access: Stay connected while you are away, so the daily search can use your mailbox
scopes.least: Nothing else. No admin consent, no access without you, no password shared with Boba.
client_id.hint: Leave empty to use Boba's bundled public client.
list.disconnect.confirm: Disconnect {address}? Boba revokes the access where it can and deletes the stored tokens.
troubleshoot: Boba only accepts the reply on your own machine (127.0.0.1), in the browser window it opened. If that window was closed or blocked, try again — or connect with your own client ID, or use IMAP.
gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.description: Boba sends you to Google to sign in. It never sees your password, and it asks only for the access below.
gmail.scopes.heading: Google will ask you to allow
gmail.send_only: Sending only: Boba never reads your Gmail through this client. Reading Gmail uses IMAP or your own Google client.
gmail.read_needs_client: Reading Gmail needs your own Google client ID. Add it below, or stay send-only.
gmail.read_local: Boba reads only the replies about your applications, and keeps them on this device. Nothing else leaves your mailbox.
gmail.read_testing: While your Google project is in “Testing”, Google expires the access after 7 days and you will reconnect. Publish your app to stop that.
scopes.gmail.send: Send mail as you — nothing else
scopes.gmail.readonly: Read your mail — only messages that match your applications
client_secret.hint: Google prints this next to your client ID and requires it when Boba renews access. It is not confidential.
list.imap_smtp: Read-only mail access and sending: Boba never changes anything on the server, and the connection was tested before it was saved.
imap.title: Other providers (IMAP and SMTP)
imap.description: Any provider with an app password or an OAuth token: Boba tests both connections before saving anything.
imap.read_only: Boba reads your mailbox read-only — it never marks anything as read — and sends through the submission server.
